---
title: "How long should it fly for?"
---

{{< include _model.qmd >}}

```{python}
plane, layout = glider()
res = glide(plane, layout)

h_total = launch_height()
h_zoom = h_total - H_RELEASE
h_sweep = np.linspace(0, 6, 61)

# The 1:1 between metres of height and seconds aloft is a coincidence of this
# configuration, not a law -- assert it so the prose fails loudly if the model
# moves off it rather than quietly reading as a rule.
assert 0.95 < res["sink"] < 1.05
assert h_zoom > H_RELEASE
```

::: {.hero}
[`{python} f"{res['duration']:.1f} s"`]{.hero-value}
[time aloft, from a gentle toss, in still air]{.hero-label}
:::

**Answer.** It sinks at `{python} f"{res['sink']:.2f}"` m/s, so it trades launch
height for time at very nearly a second per metre (@fig-duration). The toss
supplies `{python} f"{h_total:.1f}"` m — `{python} f"{H_RELEASE:.1f}"` m from
the hand and `{python} f"{h_zoom:.1f}"` m from the zoom — and the glide spends
it at L/D [`{python} f"{res['LD']:.1f}"`]{.key}, flying at
`{python} f"{res['V']:.1f}"` m/s.

::: {.callout-warning}
## This is the floor, not the target
Nothing is optimised yet. Nearly half the height is arm, not aircraft.
:::

::: {.callout-tip}
## Specified

Asked of the user, 2026-09-03:

1. **Launch: `{python} f"{V_LAUNCH:.0f}"` m/s**, a gentle level toss.
2. **Release height: `{python} f"{H_RELEASE:.1f}"` m** — thrown from the shoulder.
:::

::: {.callout-note}
## Assumed

1. **Zoom efficiency: `{python} f"{ZOOM_EFF:.0%}"`** of launch energy becomes height.
2. **Static margin: `{python} f"{res['static_margin']:.0%}"`**, the tightest that trims.
3. **Still air** — no thermal, no gust, no lift.
:::

```{python}
#| label: fig-duration
#| fig-cap: "Time aloft against the height the glide starts from, at the trimmed sink rate. The marker is the specified toss; the dashed line is the release height alone, before any zoom."
fig, ax = plt.subplots()
ax.plot(h_sweep, h_sweep / res["sink"], label="glide from height $h$")
ax.axvline(H_RELEASE, ls="--", color="C2", lw=1.2, label="release height")
ax.plot(h_total, res["duration"], "o", color="C1", ms=7, label="specified toss")
ax.set_xlabel("launch height, m")
ax.set_ylabel("time aloft, s")
ax.set_xlim(0, 6)
ax.set_ylim(0, None)
ax.grid()
ax.legend()
plt.show()
```
